name: Minimal
title: Free Simple Invoice Template
description: A free simple invoice template with one column, generous white space and only the essentials. Fill it in online in minutes and download a clean PDF.
summary: One column, almost no rules, generous margins. Only what the client needs.
intro: One column, read top to bottom, with nothing on it that the client doesn’t need. When an invoice has three lines, this makes it look deliberate rather than empty.
explanation: A simple invoice is not a lesser one. If you bill a few items, a short and quiet page is easier to read, and easier to pay, than a grid built for forty lines.

This template uses a single column with generous margins. The dates and amount due are set as a quiet row of facts beneath the header, items are separated only by hairlines, and there is plenty of room at the foot for a personal note.
It suits writers, translators, tutors, coaches, therapists, musicians and anyone whose invoices usually have a handful of lines.
fieldsTitle: What a simple invoice still needs

fields.name: Who it is from
fields.text: Your name or business name, with an email address. Add a postal address and tax ID if your clients need them.

fields.name: Who it is to
fields.text: The client’s name, and their address if they are a business.

fields.name: A number and a date
fields.text: A unique invoice number and the date you issued it. Both are needed for anyone’s records, including yours.

fields.name: What it is for
fields.text: One line per piece of work, described plainly, with the amount.

fields.name: When and how to pay
fields.text: The due date and your payment details. This is the part a simple invoice most often leaves out.

steps.title: Open the example
steps.text: Customize this invoice opens the simple example in the generator.

steps.title: Fill in the essentials
steps.text: Your name, the client, a line or two of work. The number and dates are filled in for you.

steps.title: Add how to pay
steps.text: Your bank details or payment link, and a short note if you like.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the PDF and send it.

faqs.q: What is the simplest invoice I can send?
faqs.a: One that shows who it is from and to, a unique number, the date, what it is for, the amount, and when and how to pay. That is a complete invoice for most small jobs; add tax details if you charge tax.

faqs.q: Can a simple invoice be handwritten or typed in an email?
faqs.a: It can, but a PDF with a number and your details is easier for the client to file and for you to keep track of. The generator makes one in a couple of minutes.

faqs.q: Is this template good for one-off jobs?
faqs.a: Yes. It is designed for invoices with a few lines, which is what most one-off jobs need.
No. Clarity reads as professional. A well-set simple invoice looks more considered than a crowded one.
